description: This file defines a React component 'PostList' for rendering and managing a list of posts in a chat channel, including loading posts, handling pagination, and performance telemetry.

classes.name: PostList
classes.description: A React component for displaying a list of posts in a channel, with features like loading posts, pagination, and performance measurement.

methods.name: markAndMeasureChannelSwitchEnd
methods.description: Measures and reports the end of a channel or team switch, including performance telemetry.

methods.name: postsOnLoad
methods.description: Handles post-loading logic when the component loads or the channel changes.

methods.name: callLoadPosts
methods.description: Calls the loadPosts action with retries on failure.

methods.name: getOldestVisiblePostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the oldest visible post.

methods.name: getLatestVisiblePostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the latest visible post.

methods.name: canLoadMorePosts
methods.description: Determines if more posts can be loaded, with auto-load logic.

methods.name: getPostsBefore
methods.description: Loads posts before the current oldest post.

methods.name: getPostsAfter
methods.description: Loads posts after the current latest post.

methods.name: getPostsBeforeAutoLoad
methods.description: Automatically loads older posts for infinite scrolling.
